en:
Huh? You don't know an Ishigaki?
But he's the father of the friend you hurt!
...What? You didn't hurt any of your friends?

By the way, your throat sounds a lot better.
It's amazing how fast you recovered.

What do you mean?
Are you messing with me?

No, it's just... Yeah.
Sorry for all the weird questions.
R-Right. Talk to you later.

Oh yeah. Have you seen the news on all
those phone scams that've been going around?

Yeah, I feel like everyone was talking about them.
The ones where they pretend to be someone you know.

I dunno, but wouldn't their voice be different?
Who'd fall for something like that?

For real. Anyone dumb enough to get suckered
in by something like that practically deserves it.
Let's get out of here.
R-Right!
Dammit. That lesson came at a price.

(Something seems wrong about this.
It has to be a scam...)
(I should try to catch him in his lie.)

Hold on.
Can I actually ask you something first?
(This must be the guy that fake Taichi told me about.)
Ah, yes. I'm Akira Ishigaki. And you are?
The name's Kiryu.
Anyway, about those treatment fees...
Actually, can I ask you something first?

You've... spent some time with
Taichi before, haven't you?
Yes, of course.

Then, you know about the huge burn scar
he has across the side of his face, right?
Has he ever mentioned how it happened?

No, he's never brought it up.
It seemed best not to mention it.
(Got him.)
Kiryu-san? Is something wrong?

Not at all. I just didn't think you'd
give yourself away so easily. Thanks for that.

If you knew Taichi, you'd know
he doesn't have a scar at all.
Wh-What!?

I wasn't expecting it to be that easy.
You thieves aren't the brightest.

You fucking prick. I guess I don't have a choice
now that you caught me. Hey, c'mon out!

Man, this old fart figured us out?
What a pain in the ass.
You... You're the one from the phone.
It's me, Taichi!

Heh, guess we're gonna have to do this the hard way.
Time to beat the cash outta you!
Hey, gramps! You're finished!
P-Please, we've had enough!

You better swear... you'll never try to pull
another one of these ridiculous scams again!
O-Okay! We promise, we promise!
R-Run away!

It hasn't even been 30 seconds, you little punk.
Do you need me to teach you another lesson!?

U-Uncle Kaz, is something wrong?
You're scaring me.
Wait, is this really Taichi?
I mean, I said it was Taichi, right?

I was just calling to say hello.
Sorry, are you too busy?
O-Oh. No, it's okay.

Phew. I'm glad I got to hear your voice,
Uncle Kaz. Anyway, talk to you later!
Right. Say hi to the others for me.

Scams are everywhere... I've gotta check
who's on the other end when I answer.

Come on, Mom! You said you'd
buy me whatever I wanted!

No means no, Ayaka! Let's go find
something else for you, okay?

I don't want anything else!
I already told you, I want Haruka-chan stuff!
Did she just say Haruka?

I know that's what you want, but no stores are
going to keep her merchandise in stock these days.

L-Let's keep looking, then!
Haruka-chan's the only one I want!

Even if we find a place, I'm not buying anything
of hers for you. Her father is a very bad man, you know.

The daughter of such a terrible person must be
terrible, too. There must be someone better out there.
Mama, have you ever met Haruka-chan's dad?
Huh? O-Of course I haven't.

So you're just gonna decide he's bad
before you even know what he's like?
Maybe he's really a good guy!

L-Look, my answer is final!
I said no, so stop questioning me!
That girl is a bad apple!

Seriously. There's no way someone raised
by a yakuza could turn out okay.
So, that girl's a Haruka fan...
Hey, you.
Huh? Wh-What do you want?
Are you a Haruka fan?
Y-Yeah, I am.
Oh! Do you like her too, Mister?

Hm? W-Well, yeah.
I, um... I've always supported Haruka-chan.

Really? I didn't know there were adults
out there who like her! You're weird, Mister!

Hey, Mister. Do you know anywhere
I can buy some Haruka-chan stuff?

They used to sell it everywhere,
but now it's gone from all the stores.
Sorry, I'm not really sure.

Oh... Maybe they got rid of
it all 'cause her dad is a yakuza.

I dunno what a yakuza is, but my mom says
it means Haruka-chan's dad is a really bad man.

Oh, and she thinks that means his
daughter has gotta be bad, too.

I'm not even allowed to listen to
Haruka-chan's music anymore.
I see. I'm sorry to hear that.

By the way, when exactly did you
start liking Haruka-chan?

Um, it was a long time ago! Back when I lived in
Osaka, I went to one of her handshake events.

My family's always moving 'cause of my dad's job,
so it's been hard for me to make friends at school.
That changed at that event, though.

When I was there, I asked Haruka-chan
what I can do to make more friends.
And? What did she say?

"I'm not that good at making friends either,
but you can do it if you just keep smiling."

"Let's smile together!"
That's what she told me.
Haruka really said that?

Yup! And once I did what she said and
smiled a lot, I made tons of friends at school!
That's why I'm Haruka-chan's biggest fan!
I see. I'm glad you asked her advice.
Me too!
What's your favorite thing about Haruka-chan, Mister?
How kind she is.
How kind she is...?

Yeah. She always puts others first,
even before her own needs.
That's her greatest strength, without a doubt.
Oh, I totally get what you mean!

Even after that handshake event was over, I stayed
behind in the park so I could watch her some more.

Haruka-chan didn't sit by and let everyone else
clean up, though. She joined in right away!

When I saw that, I knew she wasn't just cute.
She was super cool, too!
Not surprising. That sounds just like her.

Huh? Why do you have that
big smile on your face, Mister?
D-Do I?
You're so weird!
Her voice.
To be honest, it's saved me many times.
I agree! Hearing her sing always pumps me up!

Four years ago, as I was about to draw my last breath,
her voice is what woke me up to reality.
Huh? Whaddya mean?

O-Oh, uh, I mean I've been using
one of her songs as my alarm clock since then.

Really!? Haruka-chan's songs are what
wake me up in the morning, too!
H-Huh. What a coincidence.
Her face.

Yeah! Isn't she so totally cute?
I love how Haruka-chan looks when she smiles!
I agree.

When I first met her, she was just a cheeky little brat,
but somewhere along the way, she started smiling.
When you first met her...?

Yeah, a-about that. It must have been
a bit before her stage debut.

Oh, really? Haruka-chan was probably
super nervous about all sorts of stuff back then.
Probably, yeah.

She was always so cute during performances, though.
Even if she was nervous, she'd smile straight through.

I'm so bad at hiding how I feel.
I wish I could be like her...
No, I think being genuine is important, too.

Haruka tends to keep her real emotions hidden away.
That's how she can act so strong and confident on stage.
I took that strength for granted, though.
Hm...? What do you mean, Mister?
Uh, never mind. It's nothing.

What I want to say is,
it's not a bad thing to express how you feel.

If you're sad, you should cry. If you're happy, you
should smile like Haruka does. There's no shame in that.
Huh...? Okay.
I'm so happy I get to talk about Haruka-chan!

I always used to see her on TV,
or talk to people about her at school...
...but everyone changed their minds after that concert.

That's when my mom started saying Haruka-chan was
raised by a bad man and I should support someone else.

Even so, I wanna keep cheering for her
after all the help she gave me!

She might not be an idol anymore,
but that doesn't mean I don't love her!

I really wanted some Haruka-chan stuff, though.
I asked for it for my birthday and everything.
...Okay. I'll go find some Haruka merchandise for you.
Huh? You will, Mister?

I will. It's your birthday, isn't it?
Think of this as a present.

You mean it!? Thank you so much, Mister!
Oh, and my name's Ayaka. What's yours?

That's your last name, right?
I wanna know your first name!
...It's Kazuma.

Kazuma-san! I can't wait for all the
Haruka-chan stuff you're gonna bring me!

All right, I'm going to get going now.
Wait for me here, okay?
Yeah, I'll be here! Thanks, Mister Kazuma!

Now then, where can I buy
some Haruka merchandise?

Maybe I should check over at Don Quijote.
They sell practically everything there.

Right, I'm supposed to be helping Ayaka look for
Haruka merchandise. I should ask if they have any.

I have a question for you. Do you sell any merchandise
here of the former idol Haruka Sawamura?

Haruka Sawamura, right? Let me go check
in the back. Please hold on a moment.
I'm sorry to keep you waiting, sir.

It looks like Haruka Sawamura merchandise has been
discontinued nationwide. We don't have anything.

Right, okay then.
I'll try somewhere else. Thank you.

You might find something at the Club SEGA
over in Theater Square.

I occasionally see people over there who exchange
all sorts of idol merchandise with each other.
Is that so? You really know your stuff.

I spend most of my free time there.
Anyway, I didn't mean to intrude.
No, you were a big help. Thanks.
Are those the idol fans that guy was telling me about?
I should try talking to them.
Excuse me. Can I ask you a question?
Huh? Whaddya want, old man?

I'm trying to find merchandise for an idol named
Haruka Sawamura. Know where I can get some?
Sawamura? Who's that?

I gotta admit, it does sound familiar.
I'm not really into oldies, though.

The chart-topping Yukitty's the only idol
worth caring about nowadays!

Whoever the premiere idol is,
I'll be there cheering her on!

So, I don't know much about people
from the past. Sorry sorry!
It's all right...
Y-Yes! What is it?

Haruka Sawamura...? Sorry, but I'm
not too familiar with national idols.
Hm? What do you mean?

W-Well, I'm all about the small-time
local beauties these days.

I don't really care much for the idols who prance
around on national TV like they're so hot. Nope.

Providing support for the hardworking
small-time idols of Japan is my life's goal!

I even have a collection of photos for idols from
Hokkaido all the way down to Okinawa. Wanna see?
M-Maybe later.

Hmph? What seems to be the matter?
You require something of me?

Haruka Sawamura... The name eludes me.
She must be an idol of the modern day, yes?

No, she actually retired three years ago.
I don't think that's very recent.
I beg to differ, good sir.

In my humble opinion, idols are better
when aged like a fine wine.

The current generation of stars all appear
the same to me. It is quite a disconcerting trend.

O-Oh. Sorry, I guess I asked the wrong person.
Forget I mentioned it.
Halt!

Why don't we let our ears bear witness to the glorious
songs of the 70s together? They are quite riveting!
I'd rather not.
Sure. What is it?
Hold on, did I hear you say Haruka Sawamura?
Y-Yeah. I need some merchandise of hers for<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>
Brother!
Wh-What?

I still remember her enchanting rise to stardom!
Retirement came far too soon for such a fair maiden!

If you really are a fellow fan of Haruka Sawamura,
that means we're brothers in love!

Y-Yeah, she's great.
Haruka-san's songs really touched my heart.

I'm building a collection of her merchandise, but it's
been tough finding things. Do you have any leads?
I seeeee.

Due to Haruka-san's turbulent retirement, all her merch
is off the shelves. It's really driven up the resale price.

The amount of time that's passed since then
has made things even more difficult, too!
So that's what happened.

However, I just heard the other day about a store
that has a super-rare photo of Haruka-san in stock.

I was about to head over and snag it for myself,
but I don't mind surrendering it to you this time.
Are you sure!? Where is this store?

Just one second. It's still possible that you're just
a lowly scalper hoping to score a sweet haul to sell later.

To prove your honor, you'll have to
answer a simple Haruka-san question.

If you get it right, I'll know you're truly my brother
and tell you where the store is.
Okay, let's do this.
All right! It's question time!

What is the name of the incredibly famous song
Haruka-san sang in her first Princess League appearance?
So Much More!
That's correct!

You really are a brother of mine!
Though, that was pretty easy...
Anyway, I'll tell you what I know.

The photo of Haruka-san is waiting for you
over at a pawn shop called Ebisu.
